_comment: Art styles the planner may pick from. Each is a complete style paragraph for the image prompt.
flat-outline: Children's picture-book illustration for ages 3 to 6. Flat, hand-drawn look with soft, confident black outlines and gentle rounded shapes. Limited palette of five muted colours plus cream. Flat fills, no gradients, no shading, no texture, no photorealism. Backgrounds are pale and mostly empty. Dark colours only in outlines and small accents, never as large areas. Warm, calm, sleepy mood. No text, letters or numbers anywhere in the image.
linocut: Children's picture-book illustration for ages 3 to 6 in the style of a hand-pulled linocut block print: bold carved black outlines with slightly uneven hand-cut edges, flat ink colours in a limited palette of five muted colours on cream paper, visible carving texture in larger areas (fine parallel hatching lines instead of gradients), no photorealism, no digital gradients, no soft shading. Backgrounds are mostly cream paper with a flat pale sky. Dark ink only in outlines, hatching and small accents, never as large solid dark areas. Warm, calm, sleepy mood. No text, letters or numbers anywhere in the image.
watercolour-ink: Children's picture-book illustration for ages 3 to 6 in loose watercolour and ink: confident brown-black ink line drawings with soft translucent watercolour washes that do not always stay inside the lines, white paper showing through, a limited palette of five muted colours plus paper white, a little granulation texture, no digital gradients, no photorealism. Backgrounds are light and airy with plenty of untouched paper. Dark tones only in the ink line and small accents, never large dark areas. Warm, calm, sleepy mood. No text, letters or numbers anywhere in the image.
screen-print: Children's picture-book illustration for ages 3 to 6 in the style of a vintage national-park screen print: flat overlapping spot colours, simplified geometric shapes for mountains, trees and animals, slight print misregistration and paper grain, a limited palette of five muted colours plus cream, no outlines except where shapes meet, no gradients, no photorealism. Backgrounds are cream with a pale flat sky. Dark colours only for small shapes and accents, never large dark areas. Warm, calm, sleepy mood. No text, letters or numbers anywhere in the image.
paper-collage: Children's picture-book illustration for ages 3 to 6 in painted-paper collage: every shape is a piece of hand-painted textured paper with visible brush marks and torn or cut edges, layered on a cream paper background, a limited palette of five muted colours plus cream, no outlines, no gradients, no photorealism. Backgrounds are mostly plain cream paper with a few large simple shapes. Dark colours only in small pieces, never large dark areas. Warm, calm, sleepy mood. No text, letters or numbers anywhere in the image.
coloured-pencil: Children's picture-book illustration for ages 3 to 6 in soft coloured pencil: visible pencil strokes and gentle hatching, rounded shapes, warm paper grain showing through, thin dark-brown pencil outlines, a limited palette of five muted colours plus cream, no digital gradients, no photorealism. Backgrounds are pale lavender or cream, never black or navy, even at night; glowing things are drawn as pale yellow halos on a light sky. Dark tones only in outlines and small accents, never large dark areas. Warm, calm, sleepy mood. No text, letters or numbers anywhere in the image.
gouache: Children's picture-book illustration for ages 3 to 6 in soft gouache in a mid-century picture-book manner: opaque matte paint with visible brush strokes, rounded simplified shapes, gentle paper texture, a limited palette of five muted colours plus cream, no hard black outlines (shapes are defined by colour), no gradients, no photorealism. Backgrounds are light and simple. Dark tones only in small accents, never large dark areas. Warm, calm, sleepy mood. No text, letters or numbers anywhere in the image.
lithograph: Children's picture-book illustration for ages 3 to 6 in the manner of a 1950s picture-book lithograph: soft grainy crayon-like texture, flat colour areas with slightly loose registration, simple friendly rounded shapes, a thin warm-brown line, a limited palette of five muted colours plus cream, no gradients, no photorealism. Backgrounds are cream and simple. Dark tones only in small accents, never large dark areas. Warm, calm, sleepy mood. No text, letters or numbers anywhere in the image.
flat-animation: Children's picture-book illustration for ages 3 to 6 in the look of modern flat 2D television animation for preschoolers: bold, simple, rounded shapes with no outlines, flat colour fills with at most one soft shadow tone per shape, a bright but gentle palette of five main colours plus cream, warm sunny light, clean simple backgrounds with one or two big recognisable landmarks drawn as simple blocks of colour, lots of open space, no gradients, no texture, no photorealism. Characters are small and cute with big simple eyes. Dark colours only in small accents, never large dark areas. Warm, calm, happy mood. No text, letters or numbers anywhere in the image.
reading-simple: Very simple, bold, clean picture-book illustration for a child learning to read: flat colours, thick soft black outlines, big rounded shapes, plain cream background with at most one prop, nothing in the picture that is not in the sentence, no scenery, no gradients, no texture, no photorealism. Limited palette of five muted colours plus cream. Dark colours only in outlines and small accents. Friendly, calm mood. No text, letters or numbers anywhere in the image.
